subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: Should experimental Claws be allowed to install/reuse process-wide plugins, and if so what explicit host-level authorization and ownership contract must be present?
rationale: The branch can technically bind package decisions to consent, but only maintainers can choose whether a role-level Claw declaration may alter shared executable runtime state or must be restricted to workspace-scoped skills.

options.title: Require a shared-host grant
options.body: Retain plugin packages only after the consented plan includes an explicit higher-level grant and records that the plugin is a shared host resource.

options.title: Defer plugin package mutation
options.body: Allow workspace-scoped skills in this lifecycle slice and keep plugin package declarations blocked until a scoped plugin or shared-resource contract is approved.

options.title: Accept role-level plugin installs
options.body: Document that every approved Claw package plugin is intentionally process-wide and accept the resulting cross-agent privilege boundary.

recommendation.title: Require a shared-host grant
recommendation.body: Retain plugin packages only after the consented plan includes an explicit higher-level grant and records that the plugin is a shared host resource.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment is the clearest item-specific statement of the unresolved role-versus-shared-runtime authorization boundary.
